C1465.title: ICS Vulnerabilities Expose Industrial Enterprises' Lack of Emergency Response Capabilities
keywords: National Industrial Information Security Development and Research Center
C1465.summary: In May 2018, the National Industrial Information Security Development and Research Center detected that a large number of industrial enterprises had critical vulnerabilities in their industrial control systems, with backdoor programs left behind allowing hackers to freely access and operate.
